sql: with o as (select market_ticker, min(created_at) t0 from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and created_at > '2026-09-25 19:12' and client_order_id not like 'limmexit%' group by 1) select o.market_ticker, o.t0, (select count(*) from incentive_market_snapshots s where s.market_ticker=o.market_ticker and s.at between o.t0 and o.t0 + interval '4 hours') n_snap, (select min(s.at)||' / '||max(s.at) from incentive_market_snapshots s where s.market_ticker=o.market_ticker and s.at between o.t0 and o.t0 + interval '4 hours') span, (select period_reward_usd||' tgt='||target_size||' disc='||discount_factor_bps||' '||start_date||'..'||end_date from incentive_programs p where p.market_ticker=o.market_ticker order by id desc limit 1) prog from o order by o.t0
